purpose: Dignity-first local intelligence that helps households keep more money, find useful opportunities and understand what is worth doing today.
evidence_rules: Missing data is never treated as zero.
Stale monetary observations are not served as current.
Modeled or inferred values remain labeled.
Sponsorship does not improve organic ranking.
Public results preserve source and observation time.
Source existence does not imply collector execution or fresh user-facing data.
dignity_rules: No personal-data sale required for core local intelligence.
Applications, purchases, payments and external messages remain user-controlled.
